connector.name: BPE (Bitcoin Pricing Engine)
connector.registryDescription: Consolidated Bitcoin market data for AI agents: BBO pricing, ML signals, funding skew, briefings.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package bpe-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the bxetech account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: BPE_API_KEY
env.description: Your BPE API key. Free tier available for evaluation; Agent tier unlocks the full briefing endpoint with ML signals, funding skew, and sentiment. Request at https://bxetech.com/contact.

env.name: BPE_BASE_URL
env.description: Override the BPE backend endpoint. Defaults to https://mcp.bxetech.com. Use https://mcp-qa1.bxetech.com for QA testing.
